papers.title: Effectiveness of digital health interventions for the management of Low Anterior Resection Syndrome (LARS) after sphincter-preserving surgery for rectal cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Zhao Y, Cao X, Niu L, Yang Z, Wang J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Low anterior resection syndrome (LARS) frequently occurs following sphincter-preserving rectal cancer surgery. Although recent studies have reported the effects of digital health interventions for LARS management, no systematic review and meta-analysis has been conducted.
METHODS: We searched five English databases and three Chinese databases from inception to 18 December 2025, supplemented by gray literature sources and reference checking. Randomized and non-randomized controlled studies involving adults who had undergone sphincter-preserving rectal surgery were eligible. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 for randomized trials and ROBINS-I for non-randomized studies. When at least two studies reported similar outcomes, meta-analysis was performed using mean difference or standardized mean difference with 95% confidence intervals, with the I² statistic used to measure heterogeneity. Narrative synthesis was used when pooling was not appropriate. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE. The protocol was registered in PROSPERO.
RESULTS: Eight studies published between 2021 and 2025 were included, and seven contributed to the meta-analysis. Digital health interventions were associated with reductions in LARS scores compared with usual care (MD = - 3.00, 95% CI - 4.17 to - 1.83; P < 0.00001; I² = 28%) and with improvements in health-related quality of life, although heterogeneity for this outcome was substantial (SMD = 0.75, 95% CI 0.17 to 1.34; P = 0.01; I² = 89%). No statistically significant between-group effect was observed for self-efficacy, with substantial heterogeneity (SMD = 0.43, 95% CI - 0.15 to 1.01; P = 0.15; I² = 79%). Anxiety and depression outcomes, assessed in a small number of trials, did not show meaningful between-group differences. Evidence for self-management, activation, satisfaction, feasibility, and other implementation outcomes was suggestive but inconsistently reported and often study-specific.
CONCLUSIONS: Digital health interventions show promising potential to reduce LARS symptom burden and may improve quality of life after sphincter-preserving rectal surgery. Nonetheless, confidence in these findings is limited by the small number of available trials, clinical and methodological heterogeneity, and inconsistent outcome measurement and reporting, particularly for psychological and intermediate pathway outcomes. Further well-designed, adequately powered studies are needed to confirm effectiveness and inform implementation in routine care.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: PROSPERO Registration: CRD420251250663.

papers.title_zh: 數位健康介入對直腸癌保肛手術後低位前切除症候群（LARS）管理效果之系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：低位前切除症候群（LARS）常見於直腸癌保肛手術後。儘管近期研究已報告數位健康介入對LARS管理的效果，但尚無系統性回顧與統合分析。方法：我們檢索五個英文資料庫與三個中文資料庫，自建庫至2025年12月18日，並輔以灰色文獻與參考文獻查核。納入成人接受保肛直腸手術之隨機與非隨機對照研究。當至少兩篇研究報告相似結果時，使用平均差（MD）或標準化平均差（SMD）及95%信賴區間進行統合分析，以I²統計量衡量異質性。無法合併時採用敘述性綜整。證據確定性以GRADE評估。計畫書已於PROSPERO註冊。結果：納入2021至2025年間發表的8篇研究，其中7篇納入統合分析。數位健康介入相較於常規照護，與LARS分數降低相關（MD = -3.00，95% CI -4.17至-1.83；P<0.00001；I²=28%），並與健康相關生活品質改善相關，但此結果異質性極高（SMD = 0.75，95% CI 0.17至1.34；P=0.01；I²=89%）。自我效能方面未觀察到統計顯著的組間效果，且異質性顯著（SMD = 0.43，95% CI -0.15至1.01；P=0.15；I²=79%）。焦慮與憂鬱結果僅在少數試驗中評估，未顯示有意義的組間差異。自我管理、活化、滿意度、可行性及其他執行層面結果的證據具提示性，但報告不一致且多為研究特異性。結論：數位健康介入顯示出降低LARS症狀負擔並可能改善生活品質的潛力。然而，由於可用試驗數量少、臨床與方法學異質性，以及結果測量與報告的不一致（特別是心理層面與中介路徑結果），對這些發現的信心有限。需要更多設計良好、統計檢力足夠的研究以確認效果並指導常規照護之落實。試驗註冊：PROSPERO註冊號CRD420251250663。
papers.score_reason: LARS主要結果異質性低（I²=28%）尚算可信，但次要結果（QoL、自我效能）異質性極高，原始試驗數少且品質不一，限制整體可信度。
papers.relevance_why: LARS是保肛手術後極常見且困擾病人的問題，數位健康介入屬可行的術後照護模式，直接關係到台灣大腸直腸外科日常追蹤照護。

papers.action: 可考慮將數位健康工具作為LARS症狀追蹤輔助手段，但因證據異質性高、試驗數少，尚不足以取代現有照護流程。

papers.title: Enhanced recovery after colorectal surgery in patients with inflammatory bowel disease to reduce hospital length of stay: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Johnson G, Theodosopoulos E, Vernon J, Schmocker S, Ahn H, Gomez J
papers.abstract:
AIM: Enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) improves outcomes in colorectal cancer surgery; however, patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) have been relatively excluded from these analyses. The purpose of this systematic review was to evaluate the effects of ERAS protocols in adult patients with IBD.
METHODS: Relevant databases were searched for randomised-controlled trials (RCTs) and controlled observational studies that assessed ERAS protocols versus conventional care in adult patients with IBD, in any language until July 21, 2025. Two authors independently identified trials, extracted data, assessed risk of bias (ROB 2.0 and ROBINS-I) and evidence certainty (GRADE). Primary outcomes were length of stay (LOS), 30-day readmissions, re-operations and complications.
RESULTS: Eighteen studies (one RCT, 17 observational) were included. LOS was significantly lower in the ERAS group (mean difference: -1.62 days; 95% CI: -2.03, -1.21, 15 studies, 4225 patients, moderate certainty). There was no difference in 30-day readmissions (odds ratio, OR: 0.83; 95% CI: 0.62, 1.12, 15 studies, 4157 patients, low certainty), 30-day reoperations (OR: 0.68; 95% CI: 0.46, 1.02, 8 studies, 2161 patients, very low certainty), or 30-day complications (OR 0.69; 95% CI: 0.45, 1.08, 14 studies, 4074 patients, low certainty). Evidence certainty was limited by non-blinding, and observational data at serious risk of bias.
CONCLUSIONS: ERAS for patients with IBD reduces LOS with no difference in 30-day readmissions, reoperations and complications. Subgroup analyses generated the hypothesis that procedure-specific ERAS pathways incorporating greater preoperative optimisation may provide additional benefit, but this requires confirmation in adequately powered randomised trials.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病(IBD)病人大腸直腸手術後加速康復(ERAS)以縮短住院天數：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：加速術後康復(ERAS)可改善大腸直腸癌手術的結果，但IBD病人相對較少被納入這些分析。本系統性回顧的目的是評估ERAS方案在成人IBD病人中的效果。方法：檢索相關資料庫，納入評估ERAS方案與傳統照護在成人IBD病人中比較的隨機對照試驗(RCT)與對照性觀察性研究，不限語言，至2025年7月21日。兩位作者獨立篩選試驗、擷取資料、評估偏誤風險(ROB 2.0與ROBINS-I)及證據確定性(GRADE)。主要結果為住院天數(LOS)、30天再入院、再手術及併發症。結果：共納入18篇研究(1篇RCT，17篇觀察性研究)。ERAS組的住院天數顯著較短(平均差異：-1.62天；95%信賴區間：-2.03至-1.21，15篇研究，4225名病人，中度確定性)。30天再入院無差異(勝算比OR：0.83；95% CI：0.62至1.12，15篇研究，4157名病人，低確定性)、30天再手術無差異(OR：0.68；95% CI：0.46至1.02，8篇研究，2161名病人，極低確定性)、30天併發症無差異(OR：0.69；95% CI：0.45至1.08，14篇研究，4074名病人，低確定性)。證據確定性受限於未設盲及觀察性資料存在嚴重偏誤風險。結論：ERAS應用於IBD病人可縮短住院天數，30天再入院、再手術及併發症無顯著差異。次群組分析產生一個假說—針對特定術式、納入更多術前優化的ERAS路徑可能提供額外益處，但此需在有足夠檢力的隨機試驗中確認。

papers.title: Comparative Effectiveness and Safety of FOLFOXIRI Plus Cetuximab Versus FOLFOXIRI Plus Bevacizumab in Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: A GRADE-assessed Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
papers.authors: Raza A, Qadri M, Fatima F, Saffi Ullah M, Ansab M, Fatima M
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. FOLFOXIRI combined with targeted agents has shown promising outcomes in mCRC. This meta-analysis compares efficacy and safety of FOLFOXIRI plus cetuximab versus FOLFOXIRI plus bevacizumab in patients with mCRC.
METHODS: A literature search was conducted across PubMed, Cochrane, Embase, Scopus, and clinicaltrials.gov until February 2025. Analysis was performed using RStudio v4.5.0. Pooled estimates are reported as hazard ratios, odds ratios, risk ratios, and mean difference with 95% CIs using random-effects model. Heterogeneity was assessed using I² statistics.
RESULTS: Four studies (3 RCTs, 1 observational) comprising 561 patients were included. Overall survival did not differ significantly between FOLFOXIRI-cetuximab and FOLFOXIRI-bevacizumab (HR: 1.22; 95% CI: 0.78 - 1.90; p = 0.386). Progression-free survival also did not differ significantly (HR: 1.32; 95% CI: 0.76-2.31; p = 0.324). Objective response rate, complete response, and partial response did not differ significantly [(OR: 1.48; 95% CI: 0.50-4.37; p = 0.4772), (OR: 1.59; 95% CI: 0.66-3.86; p = 0.303), and (OR: 1.60; 95% CI: 0.52-4.93, p = 0.414) respectively]. Depth of response showed no significant difference (MD: 15.29; 95% CI: -1.35-31.94; p = 0.07). Hypomagnesemia and acneiform rash were significantly more frequent with cetuximab (p < 0.01). However, alopecia, anemia, neurotoxicity, and all-grade stomatitis showed no difference between the two arms.
CONCLUSIONS: FOLFOXIRI-cetuximab did not improve PFS, OS, or response rates in patients with mCRC compared with the bevacizumab combination; however, it was associated with significantly higher rates of hypomagnesemia and acneiform rash.

papers.title_zh: FOLFOXIRI併用Cetuximab對比FOLFOXIRI併用Bevacizumab於轉移性大腸直腸癌之療效與安全性比較：GRADE評等系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
前言：轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）為全球癌症死亡的主要原因之一。FOLFOXIRI併用標靶藥物在mCRC已顯示出令人期待的治療成果。本統合分析比較FOLFOXIRI併用cetuximab與FOLFOXIRI併用bevacizumab在mCRC病人中的療效與安全性。
方法：於2025年2月前檢索PubMed、Cochrane、Embase、Scopus及clinicaltrials.gov資料庫。使用RStudio v4.5.0進行分析。採隨機效應模型，以風險比（HR）、勝算比（OR）、風險比（RR）及平均差（MD）合併估計值並附95%信賴區間。異質性以I²統計量評估。
結果：共納入4篇研究（3篇RCT、1篇觀察性研究），合計561名病人。整體存活率在FOLFOXIRI-cetuximab組與FOLFOXIRI-bevacizumab組之間無顯著差異（HR：1.22；95% CI：0.78–1.90；p = 0.386）。無惡化存活期亦無顯著差異（HR：1.32；95% CI：0.76–2.31；p = 0.324）。客觀反應率、完全反應、部分反應均無顯著差異〔分別為OR：1.48（95% CI：0.50–4.37；p = 0.4772）、OR：1.59（95% CI：0.66–3.86；p = 0.303）、OR：1.60（95% CI：0.52–4.93；p = 0.414）〕。反應深度無顯著差異（MD：15.29；95% CI：-1.35至31.94；p = 0.07）。低血鎂症與痤瘡樣皮疹在cetuximab組顯著較常見（p < 0.01）。然而，落髮、貧血、神經毒性及各級口腔黏膜炎在兩組間無差異。
結論：與bevacizumab併用相比，FOLFOXIRI-cetuximab並未改善mCRC病人的PFS、OS或反應率；但其與顯著較高的低血鎂症及痤瘡樣皮疹發生率相關。

papers.title: 16S rRNA Datasets of Gut Microbiota in Stent-Based Diverting Technique and Ileostomy from A Prospective, Open-Label, Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: Wu Z, Tong Y, Chen W, Chen W, Li L, Huang D
papers.abstract: Accumulating evidence implicates gut dysbiosis in postoperative complications and delayed intestinal recovery after rectal cancer surgery. Although stent-based diverting technique (SDT) and conventional ileostomy exert divergent impacts on gut microbial balance, high-quality comparative microbiome data from randomized trials are lacking. We report a 16S rRNA amplicon dataset from 80 patients randomized to SDT (n = 37) or ileostomy (n = 43), with fecal samples collected preoperatively and on postoperative day 90. We characterized phylum-level taxonomic composition, α-diversity and intergroup β-diversity across four subgroups, and identified discriminatory taxa via LEfSe. Functional prediction detected differential metabolic pathways after surgery. We additionally performed correlation analyses to link clinical covariates with microbial signatures. This public dataset enables independent reprocessing and cross-study comparisons, facilitating exploration of diversion-strategy-specific microbial remodeling and validation of SDT's gut microbiota-preserving capacity.

papers.title: PSC-DM: A Validated Clinical Diagnostic Model for Distinguishing Primary From Secondary Sclerosing Cholangitis
papers.journal_full: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
papers.authors: Scaravaglio M, Motta R, Cristoferi L, Maino C, Marini A, Nofit E
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is a rare, progressive cholangiopathy for which diagnosis remains challenging because of the absence of disease-specific markers and the presence of secondary causes of sclerosing cholangitis (SSC) that closely mimic its clinical presentation. Diagnostic uncertainty can delay appropriate management and add to the psychological burden experienced by patients. This study aimed to identify clinical parameters that support the early and accurate differentiation of PSC from SSC.
METHODS: We conducted a multicentre retrospective study of adults with an established diagnosis of PSC or SSC. Independent predictors of PSC were identified using multivariable logistic regression and externally validated in an independent cohort.
RESULTS: In the derivation cohort (n = 234, 155 PSC, 79 SSC), six variables were independently associated with PSC diagnosis, including younger age at presentation (p < 0.0001), presence of IBD (p < 0.0001), absence of prior hepato-pancreato-biliary surgery (p < 0.0001), autoimmune comorbidities (p = 0.0038), family history of autoimmune diseases (p = 0.0086), and absence of pancreatic abnormalities (p = 0.0338). These variables were used to develop the PSC diagnostic model (PSC-DM). In the external validation cohort (n = 142, 98 PSC, 44 SSC), the AUROC of PSC-DM was 0.95 (95% CI 0.91-0.98). In an exploratory analysis, PSC-DM significantly improved non-expert diagnostic accuracy (94.3% versus 78.6%, p = 0.0023).
CONCLUSIONS: PSC-DM is a simple, externally validated clinical prediction model that accurately distinguishes PSC from SSC using routinely available clinical variables. It may support initial diagnostic assessment in non-specialist settings, facilitate timely referral to expert centres and improve patient selection for clinical trials.
Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is a rare immune‐mediated disease that affects the bile ducts and liver. It can be difficult to diagnose particularly for non‐specialists, because it is uncommon, the initial symptoms often resemble those of other conditions and there is no single test that can reliably confirm the diagnosis. These challenges can lead to significant delays in diagnosis, causing uncertainty and psychological distress for patients and reducing opportunities for early specialist care. The PSC Diagnostic Model (PSC‐DM) helps address the diagnostic challenge of PSC using six routinely available clinical features to accurately distinguish PSC from other causes of sclerosing cholangitis. By supporting earlier and more accurate diagnosis, PSC‐DM may help patients access appropriate specialist care sooner and improve consistency in the selection of participants for PSC research studies and clinical trials.

papers.title_zh: PSC-DM：一項已驗證的臨床診斷模型，用於區分原發性與次發性硬化性膽管炎
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：原發性硬化性膽管炎（PSC）是一種罕見且進行性的膽管病變，因缺乏疾病特異性標記，且與臨床表現相似的次發性硬化性膽管炎（SSC）難以區分，診斷上極具挑戰。診斷不確定性可能延誤適當治療，並加重患者的心理負擔。本研究旨在找出有助於早期且準確區分PSC與SSC的臨床參數。
方法：我們進行一項多中心回溯性研究，納入已確診PSC或SSC之成人患者。使用多變項邏輯回歸找出PSC的獨立預測因子，並在獨立世代中進行外部驗證。
結果：在推導世代（n=234，155例PSC，79例SSC）中，六項變項與PSC診斷獨立相關，包括發病年齡較輕（p<0.0001）、有發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）（p<0.0001）、無先前肝胰膽手術史（p<0.0001）、有自體免疫共病（p=0.0038）、有自體免疫疾病家族史（p=0.0086），以及無胰臟異常（p=0.0338）。這些變項被用來建立PSC診斷模型（PSC-DM）。在外部驗證世代（n=142，98例PSC，44例SSC）中，PSC-DM的AUROC為0.95（95% CI 0.91-0.98）。在探索性分析中，PSC-DM顯著提升非專科醫師的診斷準確率（94.3% 對比 78.6%，p=0.0023）。
結論：PSC-DM是一個簡單、經外部驗證的臨床預測模型，可利用常規可得的臨床變項準確區分PSC與SSC。它可能有助於非專科環境下的初步診斷評估，促進及時轉診至專家中心，並改善臨床試驗受試者的篩選。

papers.title: Anterior tumour location as a risk factor for local recurrence after laparoscopic surgery for stage I ultra-low rectal cancers: exploratory analysis of the Ultimate trial
papers.ptype: Multicenter Study, Clinical Trial, Phase II
papers.authors: Kohyama A, Ohnuma S, Tsukada Y, Unno M, Watanabe J, Fukunaga Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anterior tumour location is an established risk factor for local recurrence (LR) in advanced rectal cancer, but its significance in stage I ultra-low rectal cancer remains unclear.
METHODS: This exploratory supplemental analysis used data from Ultimate trial, a multicentre prospective phase II study across 47 Japanese institutions (2014-2017). Patients with cT1-2 N0 M0 ultra-low rectal cancer (≤ 5 cm from the anal verge) underwent laparoscopic resection. Tumour location was categorized as anterior (10-2 o'clock) or non-anterior (2-10 o'clock). The primary endpoint was LR; secondary endpoints included recurrence-free survival, overall survival, and stoma-free survival.
RESULTS: Of 300 enrolled patients, 297 were analysed (median follow-up 37.2 months); 93 tumours (31.3%) were anterior. Baseline characteristics, operative outcomes, and pathological findings were similar between the two groups. The 3-year cumulative LR rate was 11.9% for anterior tumours and 3.0% for non-anterior tumours (hazard ratio (HR) 4.46; 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 1.67 to 11.89; P = 0.001). Multivariable analysis showed an independent association between anterior location and LR (HR 4.68; 95% c.i. 1.72 to 12.74); subgroup analysis revealed no difference in clinical (c) T1 patients, but a significantly higher LR rate for anterior tumours in cT2 patients (25.3% versus 4.7%; P < 0.001). Three-year recurrence-free survival (83.9% for anterior tumours versus 88.9% for non-anterior tumours; P = 0.222), overall survival (> 95%), and stoma-free survival were comparable between the two groups.
CONCLUSION: Anterior tumour location in the ultra-low rectum was associated with an increased risk of LR, particularly in cT2 patients, highlighting the need for a more refined treatment strategy and vigilant monitoring.

papers.title: Association of the Flemish Triage Risk Screening Tool with postoperative outcomes in older adults after colorectal cancer surgery: retrospective cohort study
papers.authors: Ghignone F, Ugolini G, Montroni I, Banchini F, Catena F, Cavaliere D
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Older adults undergoing colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery are at increased risk of postoperative complications, mortality, and loss of independence. Frailty screening tools may support perioperative risk stratification. This study evaluated the association between the Flemish Triage Risk Screening Tool (fTRST) and postoperative outcomes.
METHODS: This retrospective multicentre cohort study analysed the Emilia-Romagna Surgical Colorectal Audit. Patients aged ≥ 70 years undergoing CRC surgery (2019-2023) were included. Patients with fTRST scores ≥ 2 and < 2 were matched 1 : 1 using propensity score matching. Primary outcomes were 30-, 90-, and 180-day mortality and complications. Secondary outcomes included prolonged hospital stay and discharge to a non-independent setting. Logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analyses were performed.
RESULTS: In all, 1539 patients were included in the study. Mortality at 30, 90, and 180 days was 4.2%, 7.1%, and 10.5%, respectively. In the unmatched cohort, each 1-point increase in fTRST score was significantly associated with 30-day mortality (odds ratio (OR) 1.36; 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 1.12 to 1.66), complications (OR 1.12; 95% c.i. 1.02 to 1.23), prolonged hospital stay (OR 1.13; 95% c.i. 1.03 to 1.24), and discharge to a non-independent setting (OR 1.35; 95% c.i. 1.21 to 1.51). After matching 566 pairs, higher fTRST score remained significantly associated with 30-day mortality (OR 1.33; 95% c.i. 1.09 to 1.63) and discharge to a non-independent setting (OR 1.40; 95% c.i. 1.25 to 1.59). ROC analysis using an fTRST cut-off of ≥2 showed moderate discrimination for 30-day mortality and discharge to a non-independent setting, with areas under the ROC curve of 72.4% (negative predictive value 98.2%) and 67.2% (positive predictive value 66.3%), respectively.
CONCLUSIONS: The fTRST is a simple screening tool for identifying older adults at risk of adverse postoperative and functional outcomes after CRC surgery, supporting perioperative planning.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：接受大腸直腸癌（CRC）手術之老年病人，術後併發症、死亡率及獨立生活能力喪失之風險增加。衰弱篩檢工具可能有助於圍手術期風險分層。本研究評估弗拉芒分流風險篩檢工具（fTRST）與術後結果之關聯性。方法：此回溯性多中心世代研究分析Emilia-Romagna大腸直腸手術審核資料庫。納入2019-2023年間年齡≥70歲接受CRC手術之病人。以傾向分數配對將fTRST分數≥2與<2之病人以1:1比例配對。主要結果為術後30天、90天、180天死亡率及併發症。次要結果包括延長住院天數及出院至非獨立照護機構。進行邏輯回歸與ROC曲線分析。結果：共納入1539名病人。30天、90天、180天死亡率分別為4.2%、7.1%、10.5%。在未配對世代中，fTRST分數每增加1分，與30天死亡率（勝算比（OR）1.36；95%信賴區間（CI）1.12至1.66）、併發症（OR 1.12；95% CI 1.02至1.23）、延長住院（OR 1.13；95% CI 1.03至1.24）及出院至非獨立照護機構（OR 1.35；95% CI 1.21至1.51）均顯著相關。配對566對後，較高fTRST分數仍與30天死亡率（OR 1.33；95% CI 1.09至1.63）及出院至非獨立照護機構（OR 1.40；95% CI 1.25至1.59）顯著相關。以fTRST切點≥2進行ROC分析，顯示對30天死亡率及出院至非獨立照護機構之中等鑑別力，ROC曲線下面積分別為72.4%（陰性預測值98.2%）及67.2%（陽性預測值66.3%）。結論：fTRST是簡單易用的篩檢工具，可用於辨識CRC手術後老年病人之不良術後與功能性結果風險，有助於圍手術期規劃。

papers.title: Optimization of spectral photon-counting CT reconstruction parameters for improved detection of peritoneal metastases compared with energy-integrating detector dual-energy CT: a phantom study
papers.authors: Greffier J, Grange R, Dabli D, Houmeau A, Antonuccio M, Rousset P
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To determine the best combination of reconstruction parameters on a spectral photon-counting CT (SPCCT) system to improve detection of peritoneal metastases (PMs) on virtual monoenergetic images (VMIs) at 40 keV.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A spectral phantom was scanned using SPCCT and dual-energy CT (EID-DECT) at 8.5 mGy (CTDIvol). 40 keV VMIs were reconstructed on EID-DECT using a level 4 Spectral algorithm and kernel B. For SPCCT, two reconstruction kernels (STD-B and HRB) and four iDose4 levels (i5/i7/i9/i11) were used. Noise power spectrum (NPS) and task-based transfer function (TTF) were analyzed. Detectability indices (d') for non-mucinous and mucinous peritoneal metastases (nmPMs and mPMs) were calculated.
RESULTS: Noise magnitude (-22.4 ± 0.8%) and noise texture (fav) values were lower (-21.3 ± 4.4%), but spatial resolution (f50) was higher (5.8 ± 3.4%) with STD-B than with HRB at all iDose4 levels. For both simulated PMs, d' values were higher with STD-B than with HRB (22.3 ± 0.3%). Compared to EID-DECT, noise magnitude and d' values were similar or better with STD-B at i7/i9/i11 and i9/i11 for HRB. At all iDose4 levels and with both kernels, fav or f50 values were higher with SPCCT, except for f50 at i11 with HRB.
CONCLUSION: Optimized reconstruction settings on SPCCT offer better image quality and lesion detectability on 40 keV VMIs than EID-DECT. Combining the STD-B kernel with level i9 achieved the best compromise between noise texture, spatial resolution, and detectability for simulated PMs.
KEY POINTS: Question Can the performance of a spectral photon-counting CT (SPCCT) improve detection of peritoneal metastases (PM on 40 keV images compared with a conventional dual-energy CT (EID-DECT) system? Findings SPCCT with optimized reconstruction settings improved image noise, spatial resolution, and lesion detectability compared with EID-DECT at 40 keV. Relevance Statement SPCCT may enhance the preoperative assessment of colorectal cancer patients by better visualizing small or low-contrast peritoneal lesions. Validation in larger clinical cohorts is required to confirm these findings and define standardized reconstruction protocols.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：確定光子計數光譜CT（SPCCT）系統上最佳重建參數組合，以改善40 keV虛擬單能影像（VMI）對腹膜轉移（PM）的偵測。材料與方法：使用SPCCT與雙能CT（EID-DECT）在8.5 mGy（CTDIvol）劑量下掃描光譜幻影模型。EID-DECT使用level 4光譜演算法及kernel B重建40 keV VMI。SPCCT則使用兩種重建kernel（STD-B與HRB）及四種iDose4等級（i5/i7/i9/i11）。分析噪訊功率頻譜（NPS）與基於任務的轉換函數（TTF）。計算非黏液性與黏液性腹膜轉移（nmPM、mPM）的可偵測性指數（d'）。結果：在所有iDose4等級下，STD-B相較於HRB有較低的噪訊量（-22.4 ± 0.8%）與噪訊紋理（fav）值（-21.3 ± 4.4%），但空間解析度（f50）較高（5.8 ± 3.4%）。對兩種模擬PM而言，STD-B的d'值皆高於HRB（22.3 ± 0.3%）。與EID-DECT相比，STD-B在i7/i9/i11、HRB在i9/i11時，噪訊量與d'值相似或更佳。在所有iDose4等級與兩種kernel下，SPCCT的fav或f50值皆較高，唯HRB在i11時的f50例外。結論：SPCCT優化重建設定在40 keV VMI上提供比EID-DECT更好的影像品質與病灶偵測率。STD-B kernel搭配i9等級在噪訊紋理、空間解析度與模擬PM偵測性之間達到最佳折衷。關鍵要點：問題：SPCCT的效能能否改善40 keV影像上腹膜轉移的偵測，相較於傳統雙能CT（EID-DECT）系統？發現：優化重建設定的SPCCT在40 keV時改善了影像噪訊、空間解析度與病灶偵測率，優於EID-DECT。相關性聲明：SPCCT可能透過更好地顯示小型或低對比度腹膜病灶，增強大腸直腸癌患者的術前評估。需在更大型臨床族群中驗證這些發現，以確立標準化重建協議。

papers.title: Immunomodulatory properties of umbilical cord mesenchymal stromal cells in immune disorders: immunoregulatory functions, therapeutic progress, and engineering strategies for enhanced efficacy
papers.authors: Xie C, Lu Y, Ma J, Deng M, Liu C
papers.abstract: Immune disorders remain a major global health challenge, as conventional immunosuppressive therapies are often hampered by severe side effects and unsatisfactory long-term efficacy. Umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stromal cells (UC-MSCs) have emerged as a promising therapeutic modality for various immune disorders and balance immune homeostasis by regulating various immune cells and secreting anti-inflammatory mediators. We systematically review and synthesize preclinical and clinical evidence supporting UC-MSC treatment for major immune diseases, with graft-versus-host disease, systemic lupus erythematosus, inflammatory bowel disease, and rheumatoid arthritis being prime examples. Despite the promising therapeutic outcomes, therapeutic efficacy and large-scale clinical manufacturing of UC-MSC therapies are constrained by multiple challenges. This review also systematically examines the major translational bottlenecks for UC-MSCs in treating immune disorders, including cellular heterogeneity, non-uniform preparation standards, impaired homing and biodistribution, and insufficient long-term safety data. Finally, two main avenues for enhancing UC-MSC therapeutic potential are summarized, including optimized culture strategies, such as hypoxic preconditioning, cytokine priming, and three-dimensional spheroid culture, and genetic engineering. It is hoped that we will be able to gain a deeper understanding of the development of stable and scalable UC-MSC interventions for immune diseases.

papers.title: Intratumoral microbiota: implications for colorectal cancer pathogenesis and therapy
papers.abstract: CRC is the third most prevalent malignancy worldwide and the second leading cause of cancer-related mortality. According to GLOBOCAN 2022 estimates, approximately 1.93 million new CRC cases and 900,000 CRC-related deaths occur annually worldwide. Incidence rates continue to rise in developing countries, driven by the westernization of dietary patterns, sedentary lifestyles, and increasing obesity prevalence, with a notable trend toward younger-onset disease. In recent years, mounting evidence has implicated the microbiota as a critical contributor to CRC initiation and progression. Distinct from the fecal microbiome, the intratumoral microbiome constitutes an independent, low-biomass microbial community predominantly composed of bacteria, with additional fungal, viral, and archaeal components. Microbial communities within the TME promote CRC development and progression by modulating host immune responses, metabolic pathways, and tumor cell proliferation and metastasis. Fusobacterium nucleatum, ETBF, polyketide synthase genotoxicity island-harboring Escherichia coli and Parvimonas micra represent the most well-substantiated candidate oncomicrobes, whose carcinogenic activities involve multiple intertwined pathways, including chronic inflammation, genotoxic DNA damage, immune evasion, metabolic reprogramming, and non-coding RNA regulation. Furthermore, intratumoral microbiota may serve as early diagnostic biomarkers for CRC, offer novel therapeutic targets, and provide potential biological rationale for prognostic prediction. Microbiome-based diagnostic biomarkers, such as multi-bacterial fecal/tissue panels, have demonstrated sensitivity comparable to or superior to the fecal immunochemical test in select retrospective cohorts; however, large-scale, multicenter, prospective validation remains necessary. Strategies targeting intratumoral bacteria - including antibiotics, bacteriophages, phage-guided nanocarriers, and FMT - remain predominantly in the preclinical stage. Although phase I/II trials of FMT for immunotherapy sensitization have yielded encouraging results, small sample sizes and substantial heterogeneity preclude its near-term adoption as a standard-of-care recommendation. This review systematically summarizes the latest advances in understanding the relationship between intratumoral microbiota and CRC, critically appraises the strength of evidence across different hierarchical levels, evaluates the consistency and controversies surrounding major mechanistic hypotheses, addresses methodological challenges inherent to low-biomass microbiome research, and discusses the translational potential in CRC diagnosis, therapy, and prognostic prediction.

papers.abstract_zh: CRC是全球第三常見惡性腫瘤，也是癌症相關死亡的第二大原因。根據GLOBOCAN 2022估計，全球每年約有193萬例CRC新發病例及90萬例CRC相關死亡。受飲食西化、久坐生活型態及肥胖盛行率上升驅動，發展中國家的發生率持續攀升，且有明顯年輕化趨勢。近年來，越來越多證據顯示微生物群是CRC發生與進展的關鍵促成因子。與糞便微生物群不同，腫瘤內微生物群構成一個獨立的低生物量微生物群落，主要由細菌組成，並含有真菌、病毒及古菌成分。腫瘤微環境（TME）內的微生物群落透過調節宿主免疫反應、代謝路徑以及腫瘤細胞增殖與轉移，促進CRC的發生與進展。具核梭桿菌（Fusobacterium nucleatum）、產腸毒素脆弱擬桿菌（ETBF）、帶有聚酮合酶基因毒性島的大腸桿菌及微小小單胞菌（Parvimonas micra）是目前證據最充分的候選致癌微生物，其致癌活性涉及多條相互交織的路徑，包括慢性發炎、基因毒性DNA損傷、免疫逃逸、代謝重編程及非編碼RNA調控。此外，腫瘤內微生物群可能作為CRC的早期診斷生物標記、提供新穎治療標靶，並為預後預測提供潛在生物學依據。以微生物群為基礎的診斷生物標記，如多菌種糞便／組織面板，在部分回溯性世代研究中已顯示出與糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT）相當或更優的敏感度；然而仍需大規模、多中心、前瞻性驗證。針對腫瘤內細菌的策略——包括抗生素、噬菌體、噬菌體導引奈米載體及糞便微生物移植（FMT）——大多仍處於臨床前階段。雖然FMT用於免疫治療增敏的第一/二期試驗已產生令人鼓舞的結果，但樣本數小且異質性顯著，使其短期內無法成為標準治療建議。本綜述系統性總結了腫瘤內微生物群與CRC關係的最新進展，批判性評估不同層級證據的強度，評估主要機制假說的一致性與爭議，探討低生物量微生物群研究固有的方法學挑戰，並討論在CRC診斷、治療及預後預測上的轉譯潛力。

papers.title: Beyond the Monolayer: Leveraging 3D Culture Systems to Decode Mechanisms of Drug Resistance and Therapeutic Vulnerabilities in Colorectal Cancer
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) monolayer cultures remain the workhorse of colorectal cancer (CRC) research and high-throughput screening (HTS), yet they poorly recapitulate tissue architecture, extracellular matrix (ECM) cues, metabolic gradients, and multicellular heterogeneity that govern drug response in vivo. Over the past decade, three-dimensional (3D) culture systems-including spheroids, patient-derived organoids (PDOs), tissue-originated spheroids (CTOS), and collagen-embedded models-have revealed striking 2D vs. 3D discordance in proliferation, signaling, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), plasticity, and sensitivity to standard chemo- and targeted therapies. This review synthesizes how 3D CRC models are used to decode mechanisms of primary and acquired resistance to anti-CRC therapies, from metabolic phenotypes and ECM remodeling to EMT, polarity loss, and rare invasive trajectories identified by imaging and quantification of morphologic features of CRC cells grown in 3D. Parallel advances in PDO-based functional precision oncology demonstrate that organoid drug screens can prospectively predict patient response in advanced CRC, while 3D combination screens uncover format-specific synergies that are invisible in 2D. Building on this foundation, we highlight recent technical innovations and discuss how integrating morphometric, metabolic, and trajectory-level readouts can move CRC drug discovery "beyond live/dead." Rather than propose a single best model, we outline practical guidelines for matching 3D platform choice (cell lines vs. PDO/CTOS, collagen vs. Matrigel, static vs. live-imaging HTS) to mechanistic questions and therapeutic goals in CRC. We propose an integrated roadmap-matrix-embedded 3D cultures, high-content morphological endpoints, trajectory analytics, and rigorous HTS validation-to decode resistance mechanisms and prioritize clinically actionable combinations in CRC.

papers.abstract_zh: 二維（2D）單層培養仍是大腸直腸癌（CRC）研究與高通量篩選（HTS）的主力工具，但其無法良好重現組織結構、細胞外基質（ECM）訊號、代謝梯度及多細胞異質性，這些因素皆主導體內藥物反應。過去十年間，三維（3D）培養系統——包括球體（spheroids）、病人來源類器官（PDOs）、組織來源球體（CTOS）及膠原蛋白包埋模型——已揭示2D與3D在增生、訊號傳遞、上皮間質轉化（EMT）、可塑性，以及對標準化療與targeted therapy敏感性上的顯著差異。本綜述整合3D CRC模型如何用於解讀抗CRC治療原發性與後天性抗藥機轉，涵蓋代謝表型、ECM重塑、EMT、極性喪失，以及透過3D培養CRC細胞形態特徵影像與量化所辨識出的罕見侵襲路徑。同步進展方面，以PDO為基礎的功能性精準腫瘤學顯示，類器官藥物篩選可前瞻性預測晚期CRC病人之治療反應，而3D組合篩選則能發現2D中無法看見的平台特異性協同效應。在此基礎上，我們強調近期技術創新，並討論如何整合形態計量學、代謝及軌跡層級讀數，以推動CRC藥物開發「超越存活/死亡」的侷限。本文並非提出單一最佳模型，而是提供實用指引，依據機轉問題與治療目標，協助選擇適合的3D平台（細胞株 vs. PDO/CTOS、膠原蛋白 vs. Matrigel、靜態 vs. 活體影像HTS）。我們提出一套整合路徑圖——基質包埋3D培養、高內涵形態學終點、軌跡分析、嚴謹的HTS驗證——以解讀抗藥機轉並優先篩選臨床可行的治療組合於CRC。

papers.title: Intestinal Ultrasound for Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Expanding the Role of Point-of-Care Ultrasound in the Emergency Department
papers.abstract: Patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) frequently utilize emergency department (ED) care. Intestinal ultrasound (IUS) is a noninvasive, point-of-care, radiation-free imaging modality increasingly used in outpatient IBD management. The purpose of this article is to introduce the use of IUS for the evaluation of IBD to emergency medicine physicians who utilize ultrasound as part of their clinical practice. Studies demonstrate that IUS is highly sensitive and specific for detecting active bowel inflammation. Key sonographic findings include increased bowel wall thickness and bowel wall hyperemia. IUS can also identify important IBD-related complications such as strictures and abscesses. IUS represents a promising addition to ED assessment of IBD and may serve as a valuable complementary tool for the initial evaluation of suspected IBD flare or disease-related complications. Its rapid bedside application, lack of required bowel preparation, and absence of radiation exposure make it particularly attractive in emergency and pediatric settings. Emerging evidence supports the feasibility of IUS using cart-based ultrasound systems and handheld ultrasound devices. With appropriate training, this may allow broad implementation in the ED. Further studies are needed to define optimal implementation strategies and evaluate its impact on clinical efficiency, reduction in radiation exposure, cost-effectiveness, and patient outcomes.

papers.title_zh: 腸道超音波於發炎性腸道疾病之應用：擴大床旁超音波在急診部門的角色
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者經常使用急診（ED）醫療服務。腸道超音波（IUS）是一種非侵入性、床旁、無輻射的影像檢查方式，目前在門診IBD照護中使用日益增加。本文目的是向使用超音波作為臨床實務一部分的急診醫師，介紹IUS於評估IBD的應用。研究顯示IUS對偵測活動性腸道發炎具有高敏感性與特異性。關鍵超音波發現包括腸壁增厚與腸壁充血。IUS也能辨識重要的IBD相關併發症，如狹窄與膿瘍。IUS是急診評估IBD的一項有潛力的補充工具，可能有助於疑似IBD發作或疾病相關併發症的初步評估。其快速床邊操作、不需腸道準備、無輻射暴露等特性，使其在急診與兒科場域特別具吸引力。新興證據支持使用推車式超音波系統與手持式超音波裝置進行IUS的可行性。配合適當訓練，這可能使其在急診部門廣泛實施。仍需進一步研究以確定最佳實施策略，並評估其對臨床效率、減少輻射暴露、成本效益及病人預後的影響。

papers.relevance_why: 內容為急診醫師使用床旁超音波評估IBD發作之介紹性綜述，非外科介入，且非大腸直腸外科主要照護情境。

papers.title: Childhood, adolescent, and early adult exposures and cancer risk in middle to late adulthood
papers.abstract: Although most common cancers occur in adulthood, evidence supports that the etiological relevant time period for many cancers can often extend into childhood and adolescence. This fact is especially noteworthy given the recent rise in early-onset cancers, generally defined as cancers before age 50. Two factors could contribute to strong early life influences on cancer. First, an organ may have a specific susceptibility to irreversible genetic damage from exposure at an early life stage. Second, cells with genetic damage established earlier in life will have sufficient time available to transform into cancer because many cancers require multiple decades to fully develop after initiation, and cancers from cell initiated later in life may be averted by competing causes of death. This paper reviews the main types of evidence supporting that both reasons why early-life exposures are likely to be important. First, a brief summary of the multistage process of cancer is provided, followed by insights from the initiation-promotion model of cancer, and then evidence that some tissues may be especially prone to carcinogenic damage at early ages. The review then ends with some emerging data supporting that lifestyle exposures act primarily during adolescence for breast cancer (especially premenopausal/early onset breast cancer) because of greater carcinogenic susceptibility of breast tissue during this time period; in contrast, for colorectal cancer, lifestyle factors are operative throughout life, but early life is particularly important because early tissue damage allows longer time for cancers (especially early-onset colorectal cancer) to have sufficient time to develop.

related.title_zh: 兩個出生世代研究中，生命早期可調整生活型態因子與發炎性腸道疾病風險之關聯
related.one_liner: 在117487名北歐出生世代兒童中，比較高低生活型態評分，發現1歲時高分者後續IBD風險降低（aHR 0.77），CD降幅更明顯（aHR 0.57）。

papers.title_zh: 兒童期、青少年期與成年早期暴露對中老年癌症風險之影響
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管大多數常見癌症發生於成年期，證據顯示許多癌症的病因學相關時間窗，常可延伸至兒童期與青少年期。此一事實在近年早發性癌症（一般定義為50歲前發生之癌症）上升的背景下，尤其值得關注。有兩個因素可能促成生命早期暴露對癌症的強烈影響。第一，某些器官可能對生命早期暴露所造成的不可逆基因損傷具有特定易感性。第二，較早期建立基因損傷的細胞，有足夠時間轉化為癌症，因為許多癌症在起始後需要數十年才能完全發展，而較晚生命階段才起始的細胞，其癌變過程可能因其他競爭性死因而被阻斷。本文回顧支持上述兩項原因的主要證據類型。首先簡要說明癌症多階段發展過程，接著介紹起始-促進模型的見解，再提出某些組織可能在生命早期對致癌損傷特別敏感的證據。最後，本綜述整理新興資料，顯示生活型態暴露對乳癌（尤其是停經前／早發性乳癌）的影響主要作用於青少年期，因乳房組織在此時期對致癌物的易感性較高；相對地，對大腸直腸癌而言，生活型態因子在人生各階段皆有作用，但生命早期特別重要，因為早期組織損傷使癌症（尤其是早發性大腸直腸癌）有更長的時間得以發展成形。
